about: One glossary for Predbat plan states and status strings. Meanings are paraphrased from Predbat's documentation at the pinned ref: what-does-predbat-do.md#predbat-status, predbat-plan-card.md#understanding-the-predbat-plan and customisation.md#manual-control. The C# PredbatGlossary loads this file; web/src/lib/predbat-states.json is a byte-for-byte copy checked by a unit test (run scripts/sync-glossary.sh after editing).

demand.label: Power your home
demand.description: Solar and the battery run the house. Spare solar charges the battery, or is exported once the battery is full.
demand.battery: May charge from spare solar or discharge to run the house.

charge.label: Charge from the grid
charge.description: The battery charges from the grid (and any solar), and the grid also runs the house.
charge.battery: Should rise towards the charge target.

freeze-charge.label: Hold battery level
freeze-charge.description: The battery is held at its current level and won't discharge. The grid and solar run the house; spare solar can still top the battery up.
freeze-charge.battery: Should hold steady, or rise a little from spare solar. It should not fall.

hold-charge.label: Hold at charge target
hold-charge.description: A charge was planned, but the battery is already at or above its target, so it is held there instead of charging further.
hold-charge.battery: Should hold steady at or above the target.

no-charge.label: Charge slot, no charging needed
no-charge.description: A charge slot, but the battery is already above its target, so it won't charge unless the house uses more than expected.
no-charge.battery: Usually no grid charging; the level can move with house load and solar.

export.label: Export battery to the grid
export.description: The battery is deliberately discharged: it runs the house and the rest is exported, along with any solar.
export.battery: Should fall towards the export target.

freeze-export.label: Export solar, don't charge battery
freeze-export.description: The battery won't charge; it may still discharge for the house; spare solar is exported.
freeze-export.battery: Should not rise. It may fall when the house uses more than the solar provides; that is expected, not a fault.

hold-export.label: Export paused at minimum level
hold-export.description: An export was planned, but the battery has reached the minimum level for it, so it just runs the house as normal. Export resumes if the level rises again.
hold-export.battery: Stays near the export target; it may rise from solar.

charge-export.label: Charge, then export
charge-export.predbatName: Charging and Exporting in the same slot
charge-export.description: Predbat plans both a charge and an export inside this slot: the battery charges first, then exports.
charge-export.battery: Rises during the charge part, then falls during the export part.

states.label: Power your home (holiday mode)
states.description: Normal demand mode while holiday mode lowers the expected house load.

states.label: Hold battery for the car
states.description: A car is charging, so the battery won't discharge into it. Solar, then the grid, run the house.
states.battery: Should not fall while the car charges.

states.label: Hold battery for iBoost
states.description: The hot-water diverter is running, so the battery won't discharge into it.
states.battery: Should not fall while the diverter runs.

states.label: Export solar, don't charge battery
states.description: Demand mode is overridden with freeze export (the battery may discharge but not charge), usually to stop multi-inverter cross-charging.

states.label: Inverters disagree
states.description: On a multi-inverter system one inverter is on the charge side (charging or holding) while another is on the export side at the same time.

states.label: Read-only: no inverter control
states.description: Predbat keeps planning but doesn't send any instructions to the inverter.

states.label: Read-only during an Axle event
states.description: Predbat stops controlling the inverter for an Axle VPP export event and resumes afterwards.

states.label: Battery calibrating
states.description: The inverter is calibrating the battery; Predbat pauses its plan until the calibration finishes.

states.label: Predbat reported an error
states.description: Predbat hit a configuration or other problem; its log has the details.

reasons.demand_rising: The battery should rise from solar; no charging or exporting is planned.
reasons.demand_falling: The battery should discharge to run the house; no charging or exporting is planned.
reasons.demand_steady: The battery should stay steady; no charging or exporting is planned.
reasons.hold_for_car: The battery is held so it won't discharge into the charging car.
reasons.hold_for_car_before_export: Until {split_time} the battery is held for the charging car.
reasons.demand_before_export_rising: Until {split_time} the battery should rise from solar.
reasons.demand_before_export_falling: Until {split_time} the battery should discharge to run the house.
reasons.demand_before_export_steady: Until {split_time} the battery should stay steady.
reasons.freeze_charge: The battery is held at its level rather than charged ({rate}p/kWh against a {threshold}p/kWh threshold).
reasons.hold_charge_at_target: The battery is already at or above the {target_percent}% target.
reasons.freeze_export: Spare solar goes to the grid; the battery isn't worth discharging to export this slot.
reasons.hold_export_unreachable: Export window, but the battery isn't expected to be above {target_percent}%, so it doesn't export.
reasons.manual_override_charge: You set this slot to charge.
reasons.manual_override_freeze_charge: You set this slot to hold the battery level.
reasons.manual_override_export: You set this slot to export.
reasons.manual_override_freeze_export: You set this slot to export solar without charging the battery.
reasons.manual_override_demand: You set this slot to normal demand mode.
reasons.mixed_slot_states: This slot changed state part-way through: {states}.
